def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

from lib import upscale
def transform(grid):

import re
# load demo 2
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
def grab(tag,h,w,txt):
    i=txt.index(tag+' (%dx%d):'%(h,w)); i=txt.index('\n',i)+1
    return [[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in txt[i:].split('\n')[:h]]
G2={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    if k not in G2: G2[k]=grab(k,h,w,t)
print(solve(G2['Demo pair 2 input'])==G2['Demo pair 2 output'])
ti=G2['Test input']
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(v for r in ti for v in r))
# list all non-2 cells

# Patterns (component cells with values; '.'=bg inside bbox) and observed anchors
P = {}
P[1] = dict(bg=7, g=[[1,1,0],[0,4,0],[0,1,5],[4,4,7],[0,7,7]], anch=(2,1))
P[2] = dict(bg=2, g=[[8,5,2,2,2],[2,5,0,3,2],[2,8,9,5,9]], anch=(1,2))

def cells(p):
    return [(i,j,p['g'][i][j]) for i in range(len(p['g'])) for j in range(len(p['g'][0])) if p['g'][i][j]!=p['bg']]

def check(f, name):
    ok=[]
    for k,p in P.items():
        try: a=f(p)
        except Exception as e: a=None
        ok.append(a==p['anch'])
    print(('PASS' if all(ok) else 'fail'), name, ok)

import statistics
def comp_cells(p): return cells(p)

def f_center(p): return (len(p['g'])//2, len(p['g'][0])//2)
def f_centroid_comp(p):
    cs=cells(p); r=sum(c[0] for c in cs)/len(cs); c=sum(c[1] for c in cs)/len(cs)
    return min(cs, key=lambda t:(t[0]-r)**2+(t[1]-c)**2)[:2]
def f_centroid_bbox(p):
    h,w=len(p['g']),len(p['g'][0]); r,c=(h-1)/2,(w-1)/2
    cs=cells(p)
    return min(cs, key=lambda t:(t[0]-r)**2+(t[1]-c)**2)[:2]
def f_medcell(p):
    cs=sorted(cells(p)); return cs[len(cs)//2][:2]
def f_maxcount(p):  # cell whose value most frequent, tie->closest to center
    cs=cells(p); cnt=Counter(c[2] for c in cs); m=max(cnt.values())
    h,w=len(p['g']),len(p['g'][0])
    cand=[t for t in cs if cnt[t[2]]==m]
    return min(cand, key=lambda t:(t[0]-h/2)**2+(t[1]-w/2)**2)[:2]
def f_mincount(p):
    cs=cells(p); cnt=Counter(c[2] for c in cs); m=min(cnt.values())
    h,w=len(p['g']),len(p['g'][0])
    cand=[t for t in cs if cnt[t[2]]==m]
    return min(cand, key=lambda t:(t[0]-h/2)**2+(t[1]-w/2)**2)[:2]
def f_maxval(p):
    cs=cells(p); m=max(c[2] for c in cs)
    return min([t for t in cs if t[2]==m], key=lambda t:(t[0],t[1]))[:2]
def f_minval(p):
    cs=cells(p); m=min(c[2] for c in cs)
    return min([t for t in cs if t[2]==m], key=lambda t:(t[0],t[1]))[:2]

for f,n in [(f_center,'bbox center'),(f_centroid_comp,'centroid of comp'),(f_centroid_bbox,'closest to bbox center'),
            (f_medcell,'median cell rowmajor'),(f_maxcount,'max-count color near center'),(f_mincount,'min-count color near center'),
            (f_maxval,'max value TL'),(f_minval,'min value TL')]:
    check(f,n)

def D(p): 
    g=p['g']; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    return g,h,w,p['bg']
def dist(c1,c2): return abs(c1[0]-c2[0])+abs(c1[1]-c2[1])
def euc(c1,c2): return (c1[0]-c2[0])**2+(c1[1]-c2[1])**2

# features per cell
def feats(pi):
    g,h,w,bg = D(P[pi])
    out={}
    cc=(h/2, w/2)
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            f={}
            f['v']=g[i][j]
            f['isbg']= (g[i][j]==bg)
            nb=[g[i+di][j+dj] for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=i+di<h and 0<=j+dj<w]
            f['ndistinct']=len(set(nb))
            f['nsame']=sum(1 for x in nb if x==g[i][j])
            f['nbg']=sum(1 for x in nb if x==bg)
            cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row if x!=bg)
            f['count']=cnt[g[i][j]]
            f['dcenter']=dist((i,j),(h//2,w//2))
            f['ecenter']=euc((i,j),(h//2,w//2))
            f['i']=i; f['j']=j
            # distance to comp centroid
            cellsC=[(a,b) for a in range(h) for b in range(w) if g[a][b]!=bg]
            cr=sum(a for a,b in cellsC)/len(cellsC); cj=sum(b for a,b in cellsC)/len(cellsC)
            f['dcent']=dist((i,j),(cr,cj))
            out[(i,j)]=f
    out['_h'],out['_w']=h,w
    return out

import itertools

PATS = {}
for k in P:
    g = P[k]['g']; bg = P[k]['bg']
    PATS[k] = {'g': g, 'bg': bg, 'h': len(g), 'w': len(g[0]), 'anch': P[k]['anch']}

def feat_table(p):
    g, bg, h, w = p['g'], p['bg'], p['h'], p['w']
    allvals = [x for row in g for x in row]
    nonbg = [x for x in allvals if x != bg]
    cnt = Counter(allvals); cntnb = Counter(nonbg)
    comp = [(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] != bg]
    # also full-grid comp assuming connectedness irrelevant
    T = {}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            f = {}
            f['v'] = g[i][j]
            f['isbg'] = g[i][j] == bg
            f['cnt'] = cnt[g[i][j]]
            f['cntnb'] = cntnb[g[i][j]]
            nb4 = [g[i+di][j+dj] for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=i+di<h and 0<=j+dj<w]
            nb8 = [g[i+di][j+dj] for di in (-1,0,1) for dj in (-1,0,1) if (di,dj)!=(0,0) and 0<=i+di<h and 0<=j+dj<w]
            f['nd4'] = len(set(nb4)); f['nd8'] = len(set(nb8))
            f['sum4'] = sum(nb4); f['sum8'] = sum(nb8)
            f['nsame4'] = sum(1 for x in nb4 if x==g[i][j])
            f['nbg4'] = sum(1 for x in nb4 if x==bg)
            f['i'] = i; f['j'] = j
            f['dcr'] = abs(i - h//2); f['dcc'] = abs(j - w//2)
            f['dc2'] = abs(i-h//2)+abs(j-w//2)
            f['dec'] = (i-(h-1)/2)**2 + (j-(w-1)/2)**2
            f['dTL'] = i+j; f['dBR'] = (h-1-i)+(w-1-j)
            cen = (sum(a for a,b in comp)/len(comp), sum(b for a,b in comp)/len(comp))
            f['dcen'] = abs(i-cen[0])+abs(j-cen[1])
            T[(i,j)] = f
    T['_meta'] = dict(h=h, w=w, cnt=cnt, cntnb=cntnb, comp=comp, bg=bg)
    return T

FT = {k: feat_table(PATS[k]) for k in PATS}
for k in PATS:
    m = FT[k]['_meta']
    print(k, 'h,w=', m['h'], m['w'], 'anchor', PATS[k]['anch'], 'val', PATS[k]['g'][PATS[k]['anch'][0]][PATS[k]['anch'][1]], 'counts', dict(m['cntnb']))

# Broad search: stage1 filters on value-class, stage2 scores per-cell
def stage1_preds(k):
    """yield (name, cellset)"""
    m = FT[k]['_meta']; g = PATS[k]['g']; h, w = m['h'], m['w']
    comp = m['comp']; bg = m['bg']
    cnt = m['cnt']; cntnb = m['cntnb']
    nonbg_vals = sorted(set(v for (i,j) in comp for v in [g[i][j]]))
    cen = g[h//2][w//2]
    preds = {
        'all': set(comp),
        'v_cen': {c for c in comp if g[c[0]][c[1]] == cen},
        'v_max': {c for c in comp if g[c[0]][c[1]] == max(nonbg_vals)},
        'v_min': {c for c in comp if g[c[0]][c[1]] == min(nonbg_vals)},
        'v_maxcnt': {c for c in comp if g[c[0]][c[1]] == max(nonbg_vals, key=lambda v: cntnb[v])},
        'v_mincnt': {c for c in comp if g[c[0]][c[1]] == min(nonbg_vals, key=lambda v: cntnb[v])},
        'v_maxcnt_all': {c for c in comp if g[c[0]][c[1]] == max(nonbg_vals, key=lambda v: cnt[v])},
        'v_mincnt_all': {c for c in comp if g[c[0]][c[1]] == min(nonbg_vals, key=lambda v: cnt[v])},
        'v_rank_cen': {c for c in comp if abs(nonbg_vals.index(g[c[0]][c[1]]) - nonbg_vals.index(cen)) <= 0},
    }
    return preds

S1 = {k: stage1_preds(k) for k in PATS}
for k in PATS:
    a = PATS[k]['anch']
    hits = {n: a in cs for n, cs in S1[k].items()}
    print(k, {n: v for n, v in hits.items()})

                out.append(cs)

def bbox_component(cells):
    """Bounding box (top, left, height, width) of a set of cells, plus the box grid."""
    rs = [r for r, c in cells]; cs = [c for r, c in cells]
    top, left = min(rs), min(cs)
    h, w = max(rs)-top+1, max(cs)-left+1
    return top, left, h, w
